research_question: Same-period parent-attributable YTD profit: what was already publicly disclosed before the formal report, what is genuinely additional at that report, and is the fixed additional information associated with executable forward returns?

fixed_resources.failures: Reserve before wire call; failed attempts counted; no implicit restart or replay. Uncertified coverage or unreadable accounting scope remains UNKNOWN, not no prior guidance.

timing.prior_information: guidance source_day strictly earlier than financial original source_day AND guidance decision session strictly earlier than formal decision; same decision cluster not called independently earlier tradable information

timing.latest: Use latest admitted earlier guidance or express by source day; same-day contradictory versions unresolved unless explicit replacement order is documented. Preserve first/latest chain and every intervening revision.

fixed_information_classes.positive_new: Formal actual parent profit exceeds latest admitted prior high bound after rounding allowance
fixed_information_classes.negative_new: Formal actual below latest admitted prior low bound after rounding allowance
fixed_information_classes.covered: Actual cents interval lies securely inside every rounding-consistent prior numeric interval (lower bound plus half its printed quantum through upper bound minus half its printed quantum). This means no boundary breakout; exact final value can still narrow uncertainty. It does not mean no new information or no market surprise.
fixed_information_classes.no_prior_in_scoped_catalogue: No earlier matching guidance after complete scoped catalogue; distinct from genuine surprise. No numeric baseline/zero imputation; all other channels remain unobserved
fixed_information_classes.same_cluster_only: Guidance and formal report share conservative decision cluster, no independent earlier trade opportunity
fixed_information_classes.unknown: Catalogue incomplete, amount/basis/clock conflicting or latest version unresolved; no zero filling
fixed_information_classes.rounding: Use Decimal half the least printed significant amount unit for every bound; actual financial cents use0.005yuan. Positive breakout requires actual lower interval>prior high+half-quantum; negative requires actual upper interval<prior low-half-quantum. Definite inside uses prior low+half-quantum and high-half-quantum; remaining boundary overlaps unavailable for primary classification. Explicit legally exact bounds, if any, keep stated precision. No optimized economic minimum surprise threshold.
fixed_information_classes.magnitude: signed distance outside latest interval after allowance, divided by same-period prior-year original parent profit absolute value if known and nonzero; assets-scaled distance also descriptive. Neither scale sets acceptance threshold.
fixed_information_classes.rounding_boundary_overlap: Rounding intervals overlap the earlier boundary or prior interval is too narrow to certify coverage; retain separate from covered, unknown and positive/negative breakout
fixed_information_classes.approximate_point_estimate: A forecast only says about/around/approximately a single number: retain its value and estimation error descriptively, but do not invent a hard guidance interval or admit it to either primary contrast. Ordinary forecast language with an explicit numeric lower-upper interval remains an interval.

primary_tests.population: existing formal disclosure clusters with latest report-period classification, retaining all27 report-level classifications and earlier simultaneous report lineage
primary_tests.estimand: event mean for positive_new minus event mean for covered; report empty groups as unavailable

primary_tests.population: same common classified formal event population
primary_tests.estimand: event mean for negative_new minus event mean for covered

dependence_and_diagnostics.blocks: Reuse fixed21 EX036 transitive overlapping event label interval blocks; sample whole blocks with common draws, report event-weight and block-equal means
dependence_and_diagnostics.CI: 95% descriptive percentile interval only when each arm contains at least2 distinct contributing blocks; invalid empty-arm resamples counted, neverzero
dependence_and_diagnostics.rounding_sensitivity: Also show literal printed-bound class counts so the importance of rounding is visible; do not choose the better-performing classifier

secondary_descriptive_only.early_first_news: For admitted first same-period forecasts/express within market window, compute same fixed20-session stock/sector price label and publicTXE isolated position label if market inputs ready; all first-news dates included, no profitable-date selection, no extra models/contrasts/CI
secondary_descriptive_only.no_previous_guidance: Report first-formal-without-observed-earlier-guidance population separately, without assigning surprise=0 or assuming analyst/news expectations absent
secondary_descriptive_only.price_absorption: For prior-guided periods show earliest-guidance-to-pre-formal price movement and formal-forward fixed20-session movement as descriptive paths; never infer causal market digestion merely from an average
secondary_descriptive_only.unfilled: Existing1%next-session limit, lot100, fee0.001 each side, daily-range TXE; missed orders remainNO_TRADE and missing net position return; no retry of entry
secondary_descriptive_only.economic_boundary: Event labels are not continuous account returns or annual/frequency acceptance. Sparse disclosures cannot by themselves meet original3trades/60sessions goal.

decision_policy: Distinguish whether disclosure chain can be reconstructed, how much headline amount was previously covered, whether fixed incremental information has forward/execution support, and whether sample can answer. No evidence or insufficient arm counts does not prove finance has no value. Stop direct financial-entry route if no supported usable incremental mechanism, retaining limits and a concrete restart condition; do not scan neighboring windows or thresholds to force a signal. An in-range final value can narrow uncertainty: never call it no financial news. Approximate point deviations are not hard interval breakouts. Prior-source type strata are descriptive and not extra searched tests.
